is_controller.description: `true` if the Connect application retrieving the resource controls the account and can therefore exercise [platform controls](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/platform-controls-for-standard-accounts). Otherwise, this field is null.

requirement_collection.description: A value indicating responsibility for collecting requirements on this account. Only returned when the Connect application retrieving the resource controls the account.

type.description: The controller type. Can be `application`, if a Connect application controls the account, or `account`, if the account controls itself.
